enchantment.deltamagic.spiral_clubs.desc: Hold the enchanted hoe, press X to open the spell menu, select it and press Z (aims at a mob within 32 blocks): costs 16 TP. 12 club bullets hover into a clockwise ring around the target, one per game tick at ~4.5 blocks out; 8 ticks after the last one appears, all 12 swoop in at the target, dealing 8 damage to any mob they touch.
Hold the enchanted hoe, press X to open the spell menu, select it and press Z (aims at a mob within 32 blocks): costs 16 TP. For 20 seconds, diamond bullets burst upward from the ground within a 5-block-radius circle centered on the target's position, dealing 5 damage to any mob they hit.
enchantment.deltamagic.jevil_scythe.desc: Hold the enchanted hoe, press X to open the spell menu, select it and press Z (aims at a mob within 32 blocks): costs 32 TP. Summons 4 scythes orbiting the target; after ~20 game ticks they dive at its center, keep flying through it, then resume orbiting once they reach the mob's side and repeat the dive. Lasts 15 seconds, dealing 25 damage to any mob they hit.
enchantment.deltamagic.ok_heal.desc: Wear the enchanted helmet, press X to open the spell menu, select it and press Z: summons 1 heal orb orbiting you for 30 seconds (up to 9 at once); while any orb orbits, you recover [25% of max HP + heal bonus] every 3 seconds. Right-clicking the air launches one orb forward: any entity it hits recovers [65% of its max HP + heal bonus] and gains Resistance I for 30 seconds. Costs 90 TP; each use permanently adds +2 heal bonus and -1 TP cost, capped after 15 uses (at 75 TP the spell is called "Advanced Heal"). Crafted in a crafting table: Heal Prayer book + Purple Dye + Bone Meal + Book and Quill.
effect.deltamagic.keep_going.desc: Granted after casting Ice Shock 3+ times within a minute; lasts 30s and doubles TrueIce damage dealt.
